definition: Stable Diffusion is a deep learning, text-to-image model released in 2022 based on diffusion techniques.
details: The generative AI technology is the premier product of Stability AI and is considered to be a part of the ongoing AI boom. It is primarily used to generate detailed images conditioned on text descriptions, though it can also be applied to other tasks such as inpainting, outpainting, and generating image-to-image translations guided by a text prompt. Its development involved researchers from the CompVis Group at LMU Munich and Runway with a computational donation from Stability and training data from non-profit organizations. Stable Diffusion is a latent diffusion model, a kind of deep generative artificial neural network. Its code and model weights have been released publicly, and an optimized version can run on most consumer hardware equipped with a modest GPU with as little as 2.4 GB VRAM. This marked a departure from previous proprietary text-to-image models such as DALL-E and Midjourney, which were accessible only via cloud services.

explainer.lead: Stable Diffusion is a deep-learning text-to-image model released in 2022 that generates images from text descriptions using diffusion techniques. It matters as a premier product of Stability AI and a central part of the ongoing AI boom.

tiers.eli5: You type a description, and the model gradually turns random noise into a picture matching your words, like a sculptor revealing a shape from a rough block.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers condition image generation on text prompts and also use it for inpainting, outpainting, and image-to-image translation. A pitfall is that prompt wording strongly shapes outputs, so reproducing a specific result requires careful prompt control.
tiers.paperLevel: A deep-learning text-to-image model based on diffusion techniques, developed with researchers from the CompVis Group at LMU Munich and Runway, with a computational donation from Stability.

explainer.example: Given the prompt 'a detailed painting of a lighthouse at sunset', the model produces a matching image; the same setup can inpaint a missing region of an existing image.
